+from copy import deepcopy
+from pathlib import Path
+import pytest
+from analyzer.__main__ import analyze
+from analyzer.frontend import Frontend
+from analyzer.grounding import Grounder
+from analyzer.state import ScenarioState, U
+from builders import build, INVENTORY, LIBRARY
+
+
+class StaticRetrieval:
+    def __init__(self, methods):
+        self.methods = methods
+
+    def candidates(self, action):
+        return self.methods
+
+
+class Proposal:
+    def __init__(self, handler, bindings):
+        self.handler, self.bindings = handler, bindings
+
+    def propose(self, task, payload, schema):
+        return {'hypotheses': [{'handler': self.handler, 'ui_site': '', 'reason': 'fixture request',
+                                'bindings': deepcopy(self.bindings)}], 'unresolved': []}
+
+
+def binding(parameter, value, quote, source='literal', reference=''):
+    return {'parameter': parameter, 'value': value, 'quote': quote, 'source': source, 'reference': reference}
+
+
+def test_unsupported_model_literal_is_not_used(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, LIBRARY, rows={'books': []})
+    mid = ids['BookController.lookup']
+    frontend = Frontend(project)
+    parser = Proposal(mid, [binding('key', 'invented', 'Open the first book')])
+    grounder = Grounder(project, frontend, StaticRetrieval([mid]), parser, {'facts': {}})
+    proposals, _ = grounder.step('Open the first book', ScenarioState(db))
+    assert 'key' not in proposals[0]['params']
+    assert any('Unsupported' in warning for warning in proposals[0]['unresolved'])
+
+
+def test_model_cannot_introduce_a_handler(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, LIBRARY, rows={'books': []})
+    mid = ids['BookController.lookup']
+    parser = Proposal('method:invented:MadeUp#run()', [])
+    grounder = Grounder(project, Frontend(project), StaticRetrieval([mid]), parser, {'facts': {}})
+    proposals, detail = grounder.step('Open book', ScenarioState(db))
+    assert not proposals and detail['unresolved']
+
+
+def test_context_changes_propagate_to_request(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, LIBRARY, rows={'books': []})
+    mid = ids['BookController.lookup']
+    parser = Proposal(mid, [binding('key', None, '', 'context', 'chosen_key')])
+    values = []
+    for value in ('first', 'second'):
+        context = {'facts': {'chosen_key': {'value': value, 'kind': 'default', 'quote': value}}}

+        choices, _ = grounder.step('Open book', ScenarioState(db))
+        values.append(choices[0]['params']['key'])

+

+def test_prepared_language_template_keeps_actual_reference_across_states(tmp_path):

+
+    class Parser:
+        calls = 0
+        def propose(self, task, payload, schema):
+            self.calls += 1
+            ref = next(alias for alias, item in payload['references'].items()

+            return {'hypotheses': [{'handler': 'H0', 'ui_site': '', 'reason': 'Prior response reference',

+    grounder = Grounder(project, Frontend(project), StaticRetrieval([mid]), Parser(), {'facts': {}})
+    state = ScenarioState(db)
+    _, selection = grounder.step('Read the selected book', state)
+    state.database.tables[('service', 'books')].reverse()

+def test_inference_is_id_independent_and_does_not_modify_initial_db(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, INVENTORY, rows={'reservations': []})
+    mid = ids['StockController.reserve']
+    parser = Proposal(mid, [binding('key', 'item', 'item'), binding('enabled', True, 'enabled')])
+    retrieval = StaticRetrieval([mid])
+    context = {'facts': {}, 'clock': None, 'unresolved': []}

+    b, _ = analyze(project, Frontend(project), retrieval, parser, db, context, scenario)
+    normalize = lambda answer: {(None if e['relation'] == 'executes' else e['source'], e['relation'], e['target']) for e in answer['edges']}

+from analyzer.engine import Engine
+from analyzer.paths import run_paths
+from analyzer.state import ScenarioState, U
+from builders import build
+
+
+def source(body):
+    return {'Api.java': '''import java.util.*; import java.util.stream.Collectors;
+      class Api { List<Integer> values;
+      Object run(List<Integer> rows, int lower){ BODY }
+      int mark(int number){ return number * 2; }
+    }'''.replace('BODY', body)}
+
+
+def test_filter_and_map_preserve_full_encounter_order_and_source_calls(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, source('''return rows.stream()
+      .filter(number -> number >= lower).map(number -> mark(number))
+      .collect(Collectors.toList());'''))
+    engine = Engine(project, ScenarioState(db))
+    assert engine.run(ids['Api.run'], {'rows': list(range(66)), 'lower': 1}) == list(range(2, 132, 2))
+    assert (ids['Api.run'], 'calls', ids['Api.mark']) in engine.edges
+    assert not engine.approximate
+
+
+def test_intermediate_stream_filter_is_lazy_and_captures_original_scalar(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, source('''List<Integer> seen=new ArrayList<>();
+      Object pending=rows.stream().filter(number -> {seen.add(number);return true;});
+      return seen.size();'''))
+    engine = Engine(project, ScenarioState(db))
+    assert engine.run(ids['Api.run'], {'rows': [4, 2], 'lower': 1}) == 0
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path/'capture', source('''int threshold=lower;
+      Object pending=rows.stream().filter(number -> number >= threshold);
+      return pending.collect(Collectors.toList());'''))
+    assert Engine(project, ScenarioState(db)).run(ids['Api.run'], {'rows': [4, 2], 'lower': 3}) == [4]
+
+
+def test_unknown_filter_membership_retains_alternatives_and_never_claims_exact_size(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, source('''return rows.stream()
+      .filter(number -> number >= lower).collect(Collectors.toList());'''))
+    outcomes = run_paths(project, ScenarioState(db), ids['Api.run'], {'rows': [4], 'lower': U})
+    assert {repr(outcome['result']) for outcome in outcomes} == {'[]', '[4]'}
+    engine = Engine(project, ScenarioState(db), conservative=True)
+    assert engine.run(ids['Api.run'], {'rows': [4], 'lower': U}) is U
+    assert engine.approximate
+    assert any('unknown stream membership' in warning for warning in engine.warnings)
+
+
+def test_stream_does_not_treat_project_collectors_as_java_library(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, {
+      'Api.java': '''import java.util.*; class Api {
+        Object run(List<Integer> rows){return rows.stream().collect(Collectors.toList());}
+      } class Collectors {static String toList(){return "custom";}}'''})
+    engine = Engine(project, ScenarioState(db))
+    assert engine.run(ids['Api.run'], {'rows': [4]}) is U
+    assert engine.approximate
+    assert any('unsupported stream operation' in warning for warning in engine.warnings)
+
+
+def test_stream_cannot_be_reused_after_terminal_operation(tmp_path):
+    project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, source('''Object pending=rows.stream();
+      pending.collect(Collectors.toList());return pending.collect(Collectors.toList());'''))
+    engine = Engine(project, ScenarioState(db))
+    assert engine.run(ids['Api.run'], {'rows': [4], 'lower': 0}) is U
+    assert engine.approximate

+from tree_sitter import Language, Parser
+import tree_sitter_javascript
+from analyzer.option_sources import option_sources
+
+
+SOURCE='''function(reply){var rows=reply.data;var control=document.getElementById("choice");
+  BEFORE
+  for(var i=0,l=rows.length;i<l;i++){
+    var opt=document.createElement("option");
+    opt.value=rows[i].code;opt.innerText=rows[i].name;control.appendChild(opt);
+  }
+  AFTER
+}'''
+
+
+def facts(source):
+    parser=Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language()))
+    node=parser.parse(('('+source+');').encode()).root_node.named_children[0]
+    while node.type in ('expression_statement','parenthesized_expression'):
+        node=node.named_children[0]
+    return option_sources(node,'reply')
+
+
+def test_mutating_response_array_before_loop_does_not_prove_original_order():
+    for statement in ('rows.reverse();','reply.data.reverse();','rows.sort();'):
+        assert facts(SOURCE.replace('BEFORE',statement).replace('AFTER',''))==[]
+
+
+def test_loop_local_cannot_replace_source_array_or_control():
+    for variable in ('rows','control','l'):
+        source=SOURCE.replace('BEFORE','').replace('AFTER','').replace('var opt=','var '+variable+'=').replace('opt.value',variable+'.value').replace('opt.innerText',variable+'.innerText').replace('appendChild(opt)','appendChild('+variable+')')
+        assert facts(source)==[]
+
+
+def test_later_control_clear_invalidates_published_option_source():
+    for statement in ('control.innerHTML="";','control.replaceChildren();'):
+        assert facts(SOURCE.replace('BEFORE','').replace('AFTER',statement))==[]
+
+
+def test_label_expression_cannot_delete_the_known_option_value():
+    source=SOURCE.replace('BEFORE','').replace('AFTER','').replace('opt.innerText=rows[i].name','opt.innerText=(delete opt.value)')
+    assert facts(source)==[]

+    assert history_value(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'key', 'Open book', history) is None
+    history.append({'action': 'Add book', 'result': {'__type__': 'Book', 'key': 'b2', 'title': 'Second'}})

+"""Check the exported graph against its explanations without a reference answer."""
+import argparse
+from collections import Counter
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def edges(items):
+    result = {(e['source'], e['relation'], e['target']) for e in items}
+    assert len(result) == len(items), 'Duplicate exported edges'
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--submission', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--report', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    answer = json.loads(args.submission.read_text())
+    report = json.loads(args.report.read_text())
+    assert set(answer['scenarios']) == set(report['scenarios'])
+    summary = {}
+    for sid, block in answer['scenarios'].items():
+        detail = report['scenarios'][sid]
+        exported = edges(block['edges'])
+        confirmed, possible = edges(detail['confirmed']), edges(detail['possible'])
+        assert not confirmed & possible and exported == confirmed | possible
+        evidence = {tuple(item['edge'][k] for k in ('source', 'relation', 'target')): item['grounds']
+                    for item in detail['evidence']}
+        assert set(evidence) == exported, 'Every edge needs its grounds'
+        steps = {s['n']: s for s in detail['steps']}
+        for edge, grounds in evidence.items():
+            assert grounds
+            for ground in grounds:
+                alternative = steps[ground['step']]['alternatives'][ground['alternative']]
+                assert edge in edges(alternative['edges'])
+                assert ground['source_sites'] and ground['source_locations'] and ground['applied_rules']
+                assert ground['entry'] == alternative['entry']
+        summary[sid] = {
+            'status': detail['analysis_status'], 'confirmed': len(confirmed), 'possible': len(possible),
+            'relations': dict(Counter(e['relation'] for e in block['edges'])),
+            'steps': len(detail['steps']),
+            'steps_without_request': [s['n'] for s in detail['steps'] if not s['alternatives']],
+            'steps_with_limits': [s['n'] for s in detail['steps'] if any(a['unresolved'] for a in s['alternatives'])],
+            'unresolved_count': len(detail['unresolved'])}
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'checks': [
+        'same scenario sets', 'unique edges', 'confirmed/possible partition',
+        'grounds for every edge', 'valid step and alternative references',
+        'source locations and applied rules'], 'scenarios': summary}, indent=2) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

# Skill: karpathy-guidelines

# Karpathy Guidelines

Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from [Andrej Karpathy's observations](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2015883857489522876) on LLM coding pitfalls.

**Tradeoff:** These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.

## 1. Think Before Coding

**Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.**

Before implementing:
- State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.
- If multiple interpretations exist, present them - don't pick silently.
- If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.
- If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.

## 2. Simplicity First

**Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.**

- No features beyond what was asked.
- No abstractions for single-use code.
- No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested.
- No error handling for impossible scenarios.
- If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.

Ask yourself: "Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?" If yes, simplify.

## 3. Surgical Changes

**Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**

When editing existing code:
- Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.
- Don't refactor things that aren't broken.
- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.
- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it - don't delete it.

When your changes create orphans:
- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.
- Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.

The test: Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.

## 4. Goal-Driven Execution

**Define success criteria. Loop until verified.**

Transform tasks into verifiable goals:
- "Add validation" → "Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass"
- "Fix the bug" → "Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass"
- "Refactor X" → "Ensure tests pass before and after"

For multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:
```
1. [Step] → verify: [check]
2. [Step] → verify: [check]
3. [Step] → verify: [check]
```

Strong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.

89: def substitute(expression, bindings):
90:     """Substitute reference identifiers, preserving string literals and property names."""
91:     parser = Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language()))
92:     source = ('(' + expression + ');').encode()
93:     tree = parser.parse(source)
94:     changes = []
95:     for node in walk(tree.root_node):
96:         if node.type == 'identifier' and text(node) in bindings:
97:             changes.append((node.start_byte, node.end_byte, '(' + bindings[text(node)] + ')'))
98:     for start, end, value in reversed(changes):
99:         source = source[:start] + value.encode() + source[end:]
100:     return source.decode()[1:-2]

115: def wrapper_identity(scope):

117:     if scope is None or scope.type == 'program':

122:     parent = scope.parent

124:     if (scope.type == 'function_expression' and key is not None and key.type == 'property_identifier'
125:             and parent.child_by_field_name('value') == scope):
126:         return name or text(key) or None, ancestor(parent.parent, ('object',))

182:         rest = buffer.split('://', 1)[1]

192: def shape_match(shape, template):
193:     """Literal URLs need the full route; one dynamic piece fills exactly one template segment."""
194:     for index, segment in enumerate(shape):
195:         if index >= len(template):
196:             return False
197:         expected = template[index]
198:         if expected == '**':
199:             return True
200:         if expected.startswith('{') or expected == '*':
201:             continue
202:         if segment == '{}' or segment != expected:
203:             return False
204:     if len(shape) == len(template):
205:         return True
206:     return all(expected == '**' for expected in template[len(shape):])

250: def redeclares(scope, name, wrapper):
251:     """True when this scope declares `name` itself, shadowing an outer wrapper."""
252:     pars = scope.child_by_field_name('parameters') or scope.child_by_field_name('parameter')
253:     if pars is not None and any(n.type == 'identifier' and text(n) == name for n in walk(pars)):
254:         return True
255:     stack = [scope]
256:     while stack:
257:         for child in stack.pop().named_children:
258:             if child == wrapper:
259:                 continue
260:             if child.type == 'function_declaration' and text(child.child_by_field_name('name')) == name:
261:                 return True
262:             if child.type == 'variable_declarator' and text(child.child_by_field_name('name')) == name:
263:                 return True
264:             if child.type not in FUNCTIONS:
265:                 stack.append(child)

279: def request_contexts(root, call, depth=0, visited=()):
280:     """Inline wrappers: unshadowed bare names, this.name only within the same object literal."""
281:     scope = ancestor(call.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program'))
282:     name, owner = wrapper_identity(scope)
283:     pars = scope.child_by_field_name('parameters')
284:     parameters = [text(n) for n in pars.named_children] if pars else []
285:     if not name or not parameters:
286:         return [(scope, None, {})]
287:     if depth >= 3 or name in visited:
288:         return []
289:     contexts = []
290:     for caller in walk(root):
291:         if caller.type != 'call_expression':
292:             continue
293:         receiver, callee = callee_parts(caller.child_by_field_name('function'))
294:         if callee != name:
295:             continue
296:         if receiver is None:
297:             if owner is not None or shadowed(caller, scope, name):
298:                 continue
299:         elif receiver != 'this' or owner is None or this_owner(caller) != owner:
300:             continue
301:         args = caller.child_by_field_name('arguments')
302:         values = args.named_children if args else []
303:         if len(values) != len(parameters):
304:             continue
305:         for outer, trigger, bindings in request_contexts(root, caller, depth + 1, (*visited, name)):
306:             contexts.append((outer, trigger if trigger is not None else caller,
307:                              {key: substitute(text(value), bindings) for key, value in zip(parameters, values)}))
308:     return contexts or [(scope, None, {})]

def pairs(node):
    return {text(c.child_by_field_name('key')).strip('\"\''): c.child_by_field_name('value')
            for c in node.named_children if c.type == 'pair'} if node and node.type == 'object' else {}


def literal(node):
    if node is None:
        return U
    raw = text(node)
    if node.type == 'string':
        try:
            return json.loads(raw) if raw.startswith('"') else raw[1:-1]
        except ValueError:
            return U
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except ValueError:
        return U


def constant(node):
    if node is not None and node.type == 'object':
        return {key: constant(val) for key, val in pairs(node).items()}
    if node is not None and node.type == 'array':
        return [constant(child) for child in node.named_children]
    return literal(node)


def json_value(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {key: json_value(val) for key, val in value.items() if val is not JS_UNDEFINED}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [None if val is JS_UNDEFINED else json_value(val) for val in value]
    return value


def truth(value):
    if value is U or isinstance(value, dict) and '__symbol__' in value:
        return U
    if value is JS_UNDEFINED or value is None:
        return False
    return True if isinstance(value, (list, dict)) else bool(value)


def request_guards(node, scope):
    guards = []
    current = node.parent
    while current is not None and current != scope:
        if current.type == 'if_statement':
            condition = text(current.child_by_field_name('condition'))
            alternative = current.child_by_field_name('alternative')
            guards.append('!(' + condition + ')' if alternative is not None and alternative.start_byte <= node.start_byte < alternative.end_byte else condition)
        current = current.parent
    return guards


def ancestor(node, kinds):
    while node and node.type not in kinds:
        node = node.parent
    return node


def unwrapped(node):
    while node is not None and node.type in ('expression_statement', 'parenthesized_expression'):
        node = node.named_children[0] if node.named_children else None
    return node


FUNCTIONS = ('function_expression', 'function_declaration', 'method_definition', 'arrow_function')


def substitute(expression, bindings):
    """Substitute reference identifiers, preserving string literals and property names."""
    parser = Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language()))
    source = ('(' + expression + ');').encode()
    tree = parser.parse(source)
    changes = []
    for node in walk(tree.root_node):
        if node.type == 'identifier' and text(node) in bindings:
            changes.append((node.start_byte, node.end_byte, '(' + bindings[text(node)] + ')'))
    for start, end, value in reversed(changes):
        source = source[:start] + value.encode() + source[end:]
    return source.decode()[1:-2]


def callee_parts(node):
    if node is None:
        return None, None
    if node.type == 'identifier':
        return None, text(node)
    if node.type == 'member_expression':
        obj, prop = node.child_by_field_name('object'), node.child_by_field_name('property')
        if obj is not None and prop is not None and prop.type == 'property_identifier':
            return text(obj), text(prop)
    return None, None


def wrapper_identity(scope):
    """Name and owning object literal of the wrapper defined at this scope."""
    if scope is None or scope.type == 'program':
        return None, None
    name = text(scope.child_by_field_name('name'))
    if scope.type == 'method_definition':
        return name or None, ancestor(scope.parent, ('object',))
    parent = scope.parent
    key = parent.child_by_field_name('key') if parent is not None and parent.type == 'pair' else None
    if (scope.type == 'function_expression' and key is not None and key.type == 'property_identifier'
            and parent.child_by_field_name('value') == scope):
        return name or text(key) or None, ancestor(parent.parent, ('object',))
    return name or None, None


def this_owner(call):
    """Object literal providing a stable `this` to the call, or None inside plain nested functions."""
    function = ancestor(call.parent, FUNCTIONS)
    while function is not None and function.type == 'arrow_function':
        function = ancestor(function.parent, FUNCTIONS)
    if function is None:
        return None
    if function.type == 'method_definition':
        return ancestor(function.parent, ('object',))
    parent = function.parent
    key = parent.child_by_field_name('key') if parent is not None and parent.type == 'pair' else None
    if (function.type == 'function_expression' and key is not None and key.type == 'property_identifier'
            and parent.child_by_field_name('value') == function):
        return ancestor(parent.parent, ('object',))
    return None


def url_shape(expression):
    """URL segments from the AST; `{}` marks one dynamic path piece, query strings are dropped."""
    tree = Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language())).parse(('(' + expression + ');').encode())
    operands = []

    def collect(node):
        node = unwrapped(node)
        if node is not None and node.type == 'binary_expression' and text(node.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '+':
            collect(node.child_by_field_name('left'))
            collect(node.child_by_field_name('right'))
        else:
            operands.append(node)

    root = tree.root_node
    collect(unwrapped(root.named_children[0]) if root.named_children else None)
    marker = '\uffff'
    while any(isinstance(literal(node), str) and marker in literal(node) for node in operands):
        marker += '\uffff'
    buffer, query = '', False
    for operand in operands:
        if query:
            continue
        if operand is not None and operand.type == 'string':
            value = literal(operand)
            if not isinstance(value, str):
                buffer += marker
                continue
            if '?' in value:
                value, _, _ = value.partition('?')
                query = True
            buffer += value
        else:
            buffer += marker
    buffer = browser_url(buffer)
    if '://' in buffer:
        rest = buffer.split('://', 1)[1]
        buffer = rest[rest.find('/'):] if '/' in rest else ''
    return ['{}' if marker in part else part for part in buffer.split('/') if part]


def browser_url(value):
    # https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser, steps 1-3.
    return re.sub(r'[\t\n\r]', '', value.strip(''.join(chr(n) for n in range(33))))


def shape_match(shape, template):
    """Literal URLs need the full route; one dynamic piece fills exactly one template segment."""
    for index, segment in enumerate(shape):
        if index >= len(template):
            return False
        expected = template[index]
        if expected == '**':
            return True
        if expected.startswith('{') or expected == '*':
            continue
        if segment == '{}' or segment != expected:
            return False
    if len(shape) == len(template):
        return True
    return all(expected == '**' for expected in template[len(shape):])


def entire_object(node):
    for child in node.named_children:
        key = child.child_by_field_name('key') if child.type == 'pair' else None
        if key is None or key.type not in ('property_identifier', 'string', 'number'):
            return False
    return True


def scope_label(scope):
    name = text(scope.child_by_field_name('name'))
    parent = scope.parent
    if not name and parent is not None and parent.type == 'pair':
        key = parent.child_by_field_name('key')
        name = text(key) if key is not None and key.type == 'property_identifier' else ''
    if not name and parent is not None and parent.type == 'assignment_expression' and parent.child_by_field_name('right') == scope:
        lhs = parent.child_by_field_name('left')
        name = text(lhs.child_by_field_name('property')) if lhs.type == 'member_expression' else text(lhs)
    if not name and parent is not None and parent.type == 'variable_declarator':
        name = text(parent.child_by_field_name('name'))
    return name or text(parent)[:120]


def label_origin(scope):
    """Enclosing scope carrying a user-visible name, skipping anonymous callbacks."""
    while scope is not None and scope.type in ('arrow_function', 'function_expression'):
        parent = scope.parent
        if parent is not None and parent.type == 'pair' and parent.child_by_field_name('value') == scope:
            outer = ancestor(scope.parent, FUNCTIONS)
            if outer is not None and (text(outer.child_by_field_name('name')) or outer.type == 'method_definition'
                                      or outer.parent is not None and outer.parent.type in ('assignment_expression', 'variable_declarator')):
                scope = outer
                continue
            break
        if text(scope.child_by_field_name('name')):
            break
        if parent is not None and parent.type == 'assignment_expression':
            break
        scope = ancestor(scope.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program'))
    return scope


def redeclares(scope, name, wrapper):
    """True when this scope declares `name` itself, shadowing an outer wrapper."""
    pars = scope.child_by_field_name('parameters') or scope.child_by_field_name('parameter')
    if pars is not None and any(n.type == 'identifier' and text(n) == name for n in walk(pars)):
        return True
    stack = [scope]
    while stack:
        for child in stack.pop().named_children:
            if child == wrapper:
                continue
            if child.type == 'function_declaration' and text(child.child_by_field_name('name')) == name:
                return True
            if child.type == 'variable_declarator' and text(child.child_by_field_name('name')) == name:
                return True
            if child.type not in FUNCTIONS:
                stack.append(child)
    return False


def shadowed(caller, wrapper, name):
    """True when a nested scope between the caller and the wrapper rebinds `name`."""
    scope = ancestor(caller.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program'))
    while scope is not None and scope != wrapper:
        if redeclares(scope, name, wrapper):
            return True
        scope = ancestor(scope.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program')) if scope.type != 'program' else None
    return False


def request_contexts(root, call, depth=0, visited=()):
    """Inline wrappers: unshadowed bare names, this.name only within the same object literal."""
    scope = ancestor(call.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program'))
    name, owner = wrapper_identity(scope)
    pars = scope.child_by_field_name('parameters')
    parameters = [text(n) for n in pars.named_children] if pars else []
    if not name or not parameters:
        return [(scope, None, {})]
    if depth >= 3 or name in visited:
        return []
    contexts = []
    for caller in walk(root):
        if caller.type != 'call_expression':
            continue
        receiver, callee = callee_parts(caller.child_by_field_name('function'))
        if callee != name:
            continue
        if receiver is None:
            if owner is not None or shadowed(caller, scope, name):
                continue
        elif receiver != 'this' or owner is None or this_owner(caller) != owner:
            continue
        args = caller.child_by_field_name('arguments')
        values = args.named_children if args else []
        if len(values) != len(parameters):
            continue
        for outer, trigger, bindings in request_contexts(root, caller, depth + 1, (*visited, name)):
            contexts.append((outer, trigger if trigger is not None else caller,
                             {key: substitute(text(value), bindings) for key, value in zip(parameters, values)}))
    return contexts or [(scope, None, {})]


class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.values, self.labels, self.scripts, self.options = {}, [], [], []
        self.option = None
        self.select = ''
        self.select_model = ''

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'script' and a.get('src'):
            self.scripts.append(a['src'])
        if tag == 'input' and a.get('id') and 'value' in a:
            self.values['#' + a['id']] = a['value']
        if tag == 'option' and ('value' in a or 'v-bind:value' in a):
            self.option = {'value': a.get('value'), 'label': '', 'control': self.select}
            if 'v-for' in a and 'v-bind:value' in a:
                self.option.update(collection=a['v-for'].split(' in ')[-1].strip(),
                                   value_field=a['v-bind:value'].split('.')[-1], model=self.select_model)
        if tag == 'select':
            self.select = a.get('id', a.get('name', a.get('v-model', '')))
            self.select_model = a.get('v-model', '')

    def handle_data(self, data):
        value = data.strip()
        if value:
            self.labels.append(value)
            if self.option is not None:
                self.option['label'] += value

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'option' and self.option is not None:
            self.options.append(self.option)
            self.option = None
        if tag == 'select':
            self.select = ''
            self.select_model = ''


class Frontend:
    def __init__(self, project):
        self.project = project
        self.parser = Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language()))
        self.sites, self.pages, self.trees, self.warnings = {}, {}, {}, []
        files = sorted(Path(p) for p in front_files(str(project.root)))
        for path in files:
            if path.suffix not in ('.html', '.htm'):
                continue
            page = Page()
            page.feed(path.read_text(errors='replace'))
            self.pages[path] = page
        for path in files:
            if path.suffix != '.js':
                continue
            source = path.read_bytes()
            tree = self.parser.parse(source)
            self.trees[path] = tree
            script_options = self.dom_options(tree)
            defaults = {}
            for node in walk(tree.root_node):
                if node.type == 'pair' and text(node.child_by_field_name('key')) == 'data':
                    arguments = node.parent.parent if node.parent is not None else None
                    caller = arguments.parent if arguments is not None and arguments.type == 'arguments' else None
                    if caller is not None and caller.type == 'call_expression' and re.search(r'ajax$|\$http$', text(caller.child_by_field_name('function'))):
                        continue
                    defaults.update({k: constant(v) for k, v in pairs(node.child_by_field_name('value')).items()})
            pages = [(p, page) for p, page in self.pages.items()
                     if any((p.parent / src).resolve() == path.resolve() for src in page.scripts if not src.startswith(('http', '//')))]
            for call, caller_scope, entry_call, argument_bindings in [
                    (c, outer_scope, trigger, bindings) for c in walk(tree.root_node) if c.type == 'call_expression'
                    for outer_scope, trigger, bindings in request_contexts(tree.root_node, c)]:
                if call.type != 'call_expression':
                    continue
                function = text(call.child_by_field_name('function'))
                args = call.child_by_field_name('arguments')
                if not args or not args.named_children:
                    continue
                config = pairs(args.named_children[0])
                if not config.get('url') or not re.search(r'ajax$|\$http$', function):
                    continue
                raw_url = substitute(text(config['url']), argument_bindings)
                local_definitions, _ = definitions_before(caller_scope, entry_call or call)
                # Resolve aliases only when their definition is a single expression.
                for _ in range(4):
                    changed = substitute(raw_url, {k: v for k, v in local_definitions.items()
                                                  if v and re.search(r'[\"\'](?:/|http)', v)})
                    if changed == raw_url:
                        break
                    raw_url = changed
                def parse_expression(expression):
                    parsed = self.parser.parse(('(' + expression + ');').encode()).root_node
                    return unwrapped(parsed.named_children[0]) if parsed.named_children else None
                cases = []
                for expression, conditions in url_cases(parse_expression(raw_url), local_definitions, parse_expression):
                    shape = url_shape(expression)
                    cases.append({'url': expression, 'conditions': conditions, 'url_shape': shape})
                strings = [literal(n) for n in walk(parse_expression(raw_url)) if n.type == 'string']
                prefix = next((browser_url(s) for s in strings if isinstance(s, str) and browser_url(s).startswith(('/', 'http'))), '')
                verb = str(literal(config.get('type') or config.get('method'))).upper()
                if not prefix:
                    self.warnings.append(str(path.relative_to(project.root)) + ': unresolved request URL')
                    continue
                for case in cases:
                    matches = [(mid, hv, template) for mid, hv, template in project.ix.handlers
                               if (verb == str(U).upper() or hv is None or hv == verb)
                               and shape_match(case['url_shape'], template)]
                    case['handlers'] = sorted(project.ix.preferred_handlers(matches, None if verb == str(U).upper() else verb))
                shape = url_shape(raw_url)
                handlers = sorted({mid for case in cases for mid in case['handlers']})
                if not handlers:
                    continue
                scope = ancestor(call.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program'))
                inlined = caller_scope != scope
                guards = request_guards(call, scope)
                if entry_call is not None:
                    guards += request_guards(entry_call, caller_scope)
                for case in cases:
                    case['conditions'] = list(dict.fromkeys(guards + case['conditions']))
                field_scopes = [(caller_scope, entry_call), (scope, call)] if inlined else [(scope, call)]
                definitions, fields = {}, {}
                for owner_scope, limit in field_scopes:
                    definitions, _ = definitions_before(owner_scope, limit, definitions)
                for lhs, expression in definitions.items():
                    if '.' in lhs:
                        owner, key = lhs.rsplit('.', 1)
                        fields.setdefault(owner, {})[key] = expression
                data = substitute(text(config.get('data')), argument_bindings)
                seen, stringified, body_owner = set(), False, None
                while data and data not in seen:
                    seen.add(data)
                    root = self.parser.parse(('(' + data + ');').encode()).root_node
                    node = unwrapped(root.named_children[0]) if root.named_children else None
                    if node is None:
                        break
                    if node.type == 'call_expression' and text(node.child_by_field_name('function')) == 'JSON.stringify':
                        args = node.child_by_field_name('arguments')
                        inner = unwrapped(args.named_children[0]) if args and len(args.named_children) == 1 else None
                        if inner is None:
                            break
                        data, stringified = text(inner), True
                        continue
                    raw = text(node)
                    if raw != data:
                        data = raw
                        continue
                    if node.type == 'identifier' and data in definitions:
                        body_owner = data
                        data = definitions[data]
                        continue
                    break
                body = fields.get(data, {})
                body_complete = False
                body_keys_complete = False
                root = self.parser.parse(('(' + data + ');').encode()).root_node if data else None
                body_node = unwrapped(root.named_children[0]) if root and root.named_children else None
                if body_node is not None and body_node.type == 'object':
                    body = {key: text(value) for key, value in pairs(body_node).items()}
                    body_complete = entire_object(body_node)
                    body_keys_complete = body_complete
                elif config.get('data') is not None and not body and literal(body_node) is U:
                    self.warnings.append(str(path.relative_to(project.root)) + ': unresolved request body: ' + data[:160])
                conditional_body = {key: expression for key, expression in body.items()
                                    if any(n.type == 'ternary_expression' for n in walk(parse_expression(expression)))}
                if conditional_body:
                    body_complete = False
                    body = {key: expression for key, expression in body.items() if key not in conditional_body}
                success = config.get('success')
                effects = []
                response_definitions = {}
                response_name = 'response'
                if success:
                    pars = success.child_by_field_name('parameters')
                    if pars and pars.named_children:
                        response_name = text(pars.named_children[0])
                    for node in walk(success):
                        if node.type == 'variable_declarator':
                            response_definitions[text(node.child_by_field_name('name'))] = text(node.child_by_field_name('value'))
                        condition = []
                        parent = node.parent
                        while parent and parent != success:
                            if parent.type == 'if_statement':
                                cond = text(parent.child_by_field_name('condition'))
                                alternative = parent.child_by_field_name('alternative')
                                condition.append('!(' + cond + ')' if alternative and alternative.start_byte <= node.start_byte < alternative.end_byte else cond)
                            parent = parent.parent
                        if node.type == 'call_expression':
                            fn = text(node.child_by_field_name('function'))
                            arguments = node.child_by_field_name('arguments')
                            values = arguments.named_children if arguments else []
                            storage = re.fullmatch(r'(?:sessionStorage|localStorage)\.setItem', fn)
                            dom = re.fullmatch(r'\$\(([\"\'])([^\"\']*)\1\)\.(val|text|html)', fn)
                            if storage and len(values) >= 2 and isinstance(literal(values[0]), str):
                                effects.append({'space': 'storage', 'key': literal(values[0]), 'expr': text(values[1]), 'conditions': condition})
                            elif dom and values:
                                effects.append({'space': 'dom', 'key': dom[2], 'expr': text(values[0]), 'conditions': condition})
                        elif node.type == 'assignment_expression':
                            lhs = text(node.child_by_field_name('left'))
                            if lhs.startswith(('this.', 'that.')):
                                effects.append({'space': 'form', 'key': lhs.split('.', 1)[1], 'expr': text(node.child_by_field_name('right')), 'conditions': condition})
                            elif lhs in ('location.href', 'window.location.href'):
                                effects.append({'space': 'navigation', 'key': 'href', 'expr': text(node.child_by_field_name('right')), 'conditions': condition})
                sid = path.relative_to(project.root).as_posix() + ':' + str(call.start_point.row + 1)
                if argument_bindings:
                    sid += '@' + str(caller_scope.start_point.row + 1) + ':' + str(len(self.sites))
                label_scope = label_origin(caller_scope if inlined else scope)
                options = deepcopy(script_options)
                for _, page in pages:
                    for option in page.options:
                        if option.get('collection'):
                            values = defaults.get(option['collection'])
                            label_field = re.fullmatch(r'\{\{\s*\w+\.(\w+)\s*\}\}', option['label'])
                            for value in values if isinstance(values, list) and label_field else []:
                                if isinstance(value, dict):
                                    options.append({'control': option['model'], 'space': 'form',
                                                    'value': value.get(option['value_field'], U),
                                                    'label': value.get(label_field[1], '')})
                        else:
                            options.append(option)
                self.sites[sid] = {'id': sid, 'file': path.relative_to(project.root).as_posix(),
                                   'page': pages[0][0].relative_to(project.root).as_posix() if pages else path.relative_to(project.root).as_posix(),
                                   'line': call.start_point.row + 1, 'handlers': handlers, 'verb': verb,
                                   'url': raw_url, 'prefix': prefix, 'url_shape': shape,
                                   'url_cases': cases,
                                   'body_fields': body, 'body_complete': body_complete, 'stringified': stringified,
                                   'body_keys_complete': body_keys_complete,
                                   'conditional_fields': conditional_body, 'body_owner': body_owner,
                                   'definitions': definitions, 'defaults': defaults,
                                   'dom_defaults': {k: v for _, page in pages for k, v in page.values.items()},
                                   'options': options,
                                   'labels': ' '.join(label for _, page in pages for label in page.labels)[:1800],
                                   'source': text(label_scope)[:2800],
                                   'helper_source': text(scope)[:2800] if inlined else None,
                                   'action_label': scope_label(label_scope),
                                   'effects': effects, 'response_name': response_name,

    def dom_options(self, tree):
        """Constant option elements assembled through the standard DOM API."""
        def expression_node(expression):
            parsed = self.parser.parse(('(' + expression + ');').encode())
            return unwrapped(parsed.root_node.named_children[0]) if parsed.root_node.named_children else None

        output = []
        for call in walk(tree.root_node):
            if call.type != 'call_expression':
                continue
            receiver, method = callee_parts(call.child_by_field_name('function'))
            args = call.child_by_field_name('arguments')
            if method != 'appendChild' or args is None or len(args.named_children) != 1:
                continue
            argument = args.named_children[0]
            if argument.type != 'identifier':
                continue
            scope = ancestor(call.parent, FUNCTIONS) or tree.root_node
            definitions, _ = definitions_before(scope, call)
            option = text(argument)

147: def url_shape(expression):
148:     """URL segments from the AST; `{}` marks one dynamic path piece, query strings are dropped."""
149:     tree = Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language())).parse(('(' + expression + ');').encode())
150:     operands = []
151: 
152:     def collect(node):
153:         node = unwrapped(node)
154:         if node is not None and node.type == 'binary_expression' and text(node.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '+':
155:             collect(node.child_by_field_name('left'))
156:             collect(node.child_by_field_name('right'))
157:         else:
158:             operands.append(node)
159: 
160:     root = tree.root_node
161:     collect(unwrapped(root.named_children[0]) if root.named_children else None)
162:     marker = '\uffff'
163:     while any(isinstance(literal(node), str) and marker in literal(node) for node in operands):
164:         marker += '\uffff'
165:     buffer, query = '', False
166:     for operand in operands:
167:         if query:
168:             continue
169:         if operand is not None and operand.type == 'string':
170:             value = literal(operand)
171:             if not isinstance(value, str):
172:                 buffer += marker
173:                 continue
174:             if '?' in value:
175:                 value, _, _ = value.partition('?')
176:                 query = True
177:             buffer += value
178:         else:
179:             buffer += marker
180:     buffer = browser_url(buffer)
181:     if '://' in buffer:
182:         rest = buffer.split('://', 1)[1]
183:         buffer = rest[rest.find('/'):] if '/' in rest else ''
184:     return ['{}' if marker in part else part for part in buffer.split('/') if part]
185: 
186: 
187: def browser_url(value):
188:     # https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser, steps 1-3.
189:     return re.sub(r'[\t\n\r]', '', value.strip(''.join(chr(n) for n in range(33))))
190:

192: def shape_match(shape, template):
193:     """Literal URLs need the full route; one dynamic piece fills exactly one template segment."""
194:     for index, segment in enumerate(shape):
195:         if index >= len(template):
196:             return False
197:         expected = template[index]
198:         if expected == '**':
199:             return True
200:         if expected.startswith('{') or expected == '*':
201:             continue
202:         if segment == '{}' or segment != expected:
203:             return False
204:     if len(shape) == len(template):
205:         return True
206:     return all(expected == '**' for expected in template[len(shape):])
207:

209: def entire_object(node):
210:     for child in node.named_children:
211:         key = child.child_by_field_name('key') if child.type == 'pair' else None
212:         if key is None or key.type not in ('property_identifier', 'string', 'number'):
213:             return False
214:     return True

217: def scope_label(scope):
218:     name = text(scope.child_by_field_name('name'))
219:     parent = scope.parent
220:     if not name and parent is not None and parent.type == 'pair':
221:         key = parent.child_by_field_name('key')
222:         name = text(key) if key is not None and key.type == 'property_identifier' else ''
223:     if not name and parent is not None and parent.type == 'assignment_expression' and parent.child_by_field_name('right') == scope:
224:         lhs = parent.child_by_field_name('left')
225:         name = text(lhs.child_by_field_name('property')) if lhs.type == 'member_expression' else text(lhs)
226:     if not name and parent is not None and parent.type == 'variable_declarator':
227:         name = text(parent.child_by_field_name('name'))
228:     return name or text(parent)[:120]

231: def label_origin(scope):
232:     """Enclosing scope carrying a user-visible name, skipping anonymous callbacks."""
233:     while scope is not None and scope.type in ('arrow_function', 'function_expression'):
234:         parent = scope.parent
235:         if parent is not None and parent.type == 'pair' and parent.child_by_field_name('value') == scope:
236:             outer = ancestor(scope.parent, FUNCTIONS)
237:             if outer is not None and (text(outer.child_by_field_name('name')) or outer.type == 'method_definition'
238:                                       or outer.parent is not None and outer.parent.type in ('assignment_expression', 'variable_declarator')):
239:                 scope = outer
240:                 continue
241:             break
242:         if text(scope.child_by_field_name('name')):
243:             break
244:         if parent is not None and parent.type == 'assignment_expression':
245:             break
246:         scope = ancestor(scope.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program'))
247:     return scope
248:

250: def redeclares(scope, name, wrapper):
251:     """True when this scope declares `name` itself, shadowing an outer wrapper."""
252:     pars = scope.child_by_field_name('parameters') or scope.child_by_field_name('parameter')
253:     if pars is not None and any(n.type == 'identifier' and text(n) == name for n in walk(pars)):
254:         return True
255:     stack = [scope]
256:     while stack:
257:         for child in stack.pop().named_children:
258:             if child == wrapper:
259:                 continue
260:             if child.type == 'function_declaration' and text(child.child_by_field_name('name')) == name:
261:                 return True
262:             if child.type == 'variable_declarator' and text(child.child_by_field_name('name')) == name:
263:                 return True
264:             if child.type not in FUNCTIONS:
265:                 stack.append(child)
266:     return False
267: 
268: 
269: def shadowed(caller, wrapper, name):
270:     """True when a nested scope between the caller and the wrapper rebinds `name`."""
271:     scope = ancestor(caller.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program'))
272:     while scope is not None and scope != wrapper:
273:         if redeclares(scope, name, wrapper):
274:             return True
275:         scope = ancestor(scope.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program')) if scope.type != 'program' else None
276:     return False
277:

279: def request_contexts(root, call, depth=0, visited=()):
280:     """Inline wrappers: unshadowed bare names, this.name only within the same object literal."""
281:     scope = ancestor(call.parent, (*FUNCTIONS, 'program'))
282:     name, owner = wrapper_identity(scope)
283:     pars = scope.child_by_field_name('parameters')
284:     parameters = [text(n) for n in pars.named_children] if pars else []
285:     if not name or not parameters:
286:         return [(scope, None, {})]
287:     if depth >= 3 or name in visited:
288:         return []
289:     contexts = []
290:     for caller in walk(root):
291:         if caller.type != 'call_expression':
292:             continue
293:         receiver, callee = callee_parts(caller.child_by_field_name('function'))
294:         if callee != name:
295:             continue
296:         if receiver is None:
297:             if owner is not None or shadowed(caller, scope, name):
298:                 continue
299:         elif receiver != 'this' or owner is None or this_owner(caller) != owner:
300:             continue
301:         args = caller.child_by_field_name('arguments')
302:         values = args.named_children if args else []
303:         if len(values) != len(parameters):
304:             continue
305:         for outer, trigger, bindings in request_contexts(root, caller, depth + 1, (*visited, name)):
306:             contexts.append((outer, trigger if trigger is not None else caller,
307:                              {key: substitute(text(value), bindings) for key, value in zip(parameters, values)}))
308:     return contexts or [(scope, None, {})]

"""Explicit labelled numeric extraction: narrow, evidence-only behavior."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from analyzer.state import U
from analyzer.structured_literals import literal_value


def test_labelled_integer_sequence_preserves_order():
    value, quote = literal_value('Add experiment with temperatures 0, 100 and 250', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>')
    assert value == [0, 100, 250]
    assert quote == 'temperatures 0, 100 and 250'


def test_scalar_float_requires_explicit_caller_label():
    assert literal_value('Add reagent with basic rate 0.5', 'basicPriceRate', 'double') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add reagent with basic rate 0.5', 'basicPriceRate', 'double', ('basic rate',)) == (0.5, 'basic rate 0.5')


def test_conflicting_repeated_labels_are_refused():
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 10 and temperature 20', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 10 and temperatures 20', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')


def test_malformed_collection_item_rejects_the_whole_list():
    assert literal_value('temperatures 0, 100.5 and 250', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 0, hot and 250', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 2026-10-17', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 0, 100 and 250 with a catalyst', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == ([0, 100, 250], 'temperatures 0, 100 and 250')


def test_partial_and_unrelated_numbers_are_ignored():
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 0.5', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 09:00', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 2026-10-17', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add 3 experiments in room 5', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add temperatureSensor value 100', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add temperature2 value 100', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Add 4 runs', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')


def test_one_malformed_repeated_occurrence_is_ambiguous():
    assert literal_value('temperature 10 and temperature unknown', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperature unknown and temperature 10', 'temperature', 'int') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Set temperature 10', 'temperature', 'int', ('temperature',)) == (10, 'temperature 10')
    assert literal_value('basic rate 0.5', 'rate', 'double', ('basic rate',)) == (0.5, 'basic rate 0.5')


def test_dangling_separator_repeated_labels_and_nonfinite_numbers():
    assert literal_value('temperatures 1, 2 and', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('temperatures 1 and temperatures 1', 'temperatures', 'List<Integer>') == ([1], 'temperatures 1')
    assert literal_value('Set ratio ' + '1' * 400, 'ratio', 'double') == (U, '')
    assert literal_value('Stay time of 5 minutes', 'stayTime', 'int') == (5, 'Stay time of 5')

@@ -0,0 +1,260 @@
+"""Direct source facts for Vue ``v-for`` rows and click handlers.
+
+Supported subset (anything else is omitted, never guessed):
+
+* ``v-for`` with one bare alias or ``(alias, index)``, the ``in``/``of``
+  keyword, and a collection written as a single plain ASCII JavaScript
+  identifier: ``v-for="(item, index) in myRows"`` / ``v-for="row in rows"``.
+  Any other collection expression (member access, call, filter, parenthesis,
+  literal) is unsupported: its aliases shadow matching outer aliases and
+  arguments bound to it produce no fact. A malformed attribute shadows every
+  identifier it mentions, so outer aliases of the same name never leak.
+* ``@click`` or ``v-on:click`` whose value is exactly one call to a direct
+  identifier: ``edit(item.id, 7, 'x')``. Member callees, non-calls, malformed
+  JavaScript and elements carrying both click attributes at once are omitted.
+* Arguments: ``alias.property`` with one direct property of the row alias, or
+  a JavaScript string / finite number / boolean / ``null`` literal. Strings
+  use a strict small decoder; unsupported escapes (legacy octal, unknown
+  escapes, lone surrogates, unpaired sign or any other expression) reject the
+  whole event rather than fabricate a value.
+* A fact is emitted only when every ``field`` argument resolves to the same
+  ``(row alias, collection)`` pair and the nearest v-for binding of that alias
+  is a direct-identifier collection. Literal-only calls, unknown aliases and
+  arguments from different rows or collections produce no fact.
+
+Facts are source facts only: they name the loop collection, the row alias,
+the handler and its argument shapes. No row is selected and no event is
+claimed to happen.
+
+Conservative HTML handling: a mismatched end tag invalidates the whole
+document, and ``row_events`` then returns no facts at all. HTML void elements
+never remain on the scope stack. HTML entities are decoded by HTMLParser.
+"""
+import math
+import re
+import string
+from html.parser import HTMLParser
+
+import tree_sitter_javascript
+from tree_sitter import Language, Parser
+
+_BAD = object()
+_MISSING = object()
+
+_IDENTIFIER = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*')
+_VFOR = re.compile(
+    r'\s*(?:\(\s*([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\s*(?:,\s*([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\s*)?\)'
+    r'|([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*))\s+(?:in|of)\s+(.+?)\s*\Z', re.S)
+_KEYWORD_COLLECTIONS = frozenset(('this', 'true', 'false', 'null'))
+_VOID = frozenset(('area', 'base', 'br', 'col', 'embed', 'hr', 'img', 'input',
+                   'link', 'meta', 'param', 'source', 'track', 'wbr'))
+_ESCAPES = {'n': '\n', 't': '\t', 'r': '\r', 'b': '\b', 'f': '\f', 'v': '\v',
+            '0': '\0', "'": "'", '"': '"', '\\': '\\', '/': '/', '`': '`'}
+_HEXDIGITS = frozenset(string.hexdigits)
+
+
+def _loop_scope(value):
+    """Bindings declared by one v-for value: alias -> direct collection or None."""
+    match = _VFOR.match(value)
+    if match is None:
+        return {alias: None for alias in _IDENTIFIER_TOKENS.findall(value)}
+    row, index, bare = match.group(1), match.group(2), match.group(3)
+    source = match.group(4)
+    collection = source if _IDENTIFIER.fullmatch(source) and source not in _KEYWORD_COLLECTIONS else None
+    bindings = {}
+    for name, is_row in ((row, True), (index, False), (bare, True)):
+        if name:
+            bindings[name] = collection if is_row else None
+    return bindings
+
+
+def _string_literal(raw):
+    if len(raw) < 2 or raw[0] not in ('"', "'") or raw[-1] != raw[0]:
+        return _BAD
+    body, out, index = raw[1:-1], [], 0
+    while index < len(body):
+        char = body[index]
+        if char != '\\':
+            if char in '\r\n':
+                return _BAD
+            out.append(char)
+            index += 1
+            continue
+        index += 1
+        if index >= len(body):
+            return _BAD
+        escape = body[index]
+        index += 1
+        if escape == '0' and index < len(body) and body[index].isdigit():
+            return _BAD
+        if escape in _ESCAPES:
+            out.append(_ESCAPES[escape])
+        elif escape == 'x':
+            digits = body[index:index + 2]
+            if len(digits) != 2 or any(d not in _HEXDIGITS for d in digits):
+                return _BAD
+            out.append(chr(int(digits, 16)))
+            index += 2
+        elif escape == 'u':
+            if index < len(body) and body[index] == '{':
+                end = body.find('}', index)
+                code = body[index + 1:end] if end != -1 else ''
+                if not code or len(code) > 8 or any(d not in _HEXDIGITS for d in code):
+                    return _BAD
+                value = int(code, 16)
+                if value > 0x10FFFF or 0xD800 <= value <= 0xDFFF:
+                    return _BAD
+                out.append(chr(value))
+                index = end + 1
+            else:
+                digits = body[index:index + 4]
+                if len(digits) != 4 or any(d not in _HEXDIGITS for d in digits):
+                    return _BAD
+                value = int(digits, 16)
+                if 0xD800 <= value <= 0xDFFF:
+                    return _BAD
+                out.append(chr(value))
+                index += 4
+        elif escape in '\r\n':
+            if escape == '\r' and index < len(body) and body[index] == '\n':
+                index += 1
+        else:
+            return _BAD
+    return ''.join(out)
+
+
+def _number_literal(raw):
+    text = raw.replace('_', '')
+    try:
+        value = int(text, 0) if text[:2].lower() in ('0x', '0o', '0b') else float(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        return _BAD
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        if not math.isfinite(value):
+            return _BAD
+        return int(value) if value.is_integer() else value
+    return value
+
+
+def _argument(node, raw):
+    """(alias, {'field': name}) or (None, {'literal': value}) or _BAD."""
+    if node.type == 'member_expression' and '?.' not in raw(node):
+        obj, prop = node.child_by_field_name('object'), node.child_by_field_name('property')
+        if obj is not None and obj.type == 'identifier' and prop is not None and prop.type == 'property_identifier':
+            return raw(obj), {'field': raw(prop)}
+        return _BAD
+    if node.type == 'string':
+        value = _string_literal(raw(node))
+        return (None, {'literal': value}) if value is not _BAD else _BAD
+    if node.type == 'number':
+        value = _number_literal(raw(node))
+        return (None, {'literal': value}) if value is not _BAD else _BAD
+    if node.type == 'true':
+        return None, {'literal': True}
+    if node.type == 'false':
+        return None, {'literal': False}
+    if node.type == 'null':
+        return None, {'literal': None}
+    return _BAD
+
+
+def _has_error(root):
+    pending = [root]
+    while pending:
+        node = pending.pop()
+        if node.type == 'ERROR' or getattr(node, 'is_missing', False):
+            return True
+        pending.extend(node.children)
+    return False
+
+
+def _decode_event(parser, expression):
+    """Handler identifier and decoded argument list of one click value, or None."""
+    source = ('(' + expression + ');').encode('utf-8')
+    root = parser.parse(source).root_node
+    if _has_error(root) or not root.named_children:
+        return None
+    node = root.named_children[0]
+    if node.type != 'expression_statement' or not node.named_children:
+        return None
+    node = node.named_children[0]
+    while node.type == 'parenthesized_expression' and node.named_children:
+        node = node.named_children[0]
+    if node.type != 'call_expression':
+        return None
+    function = node.child_by_field_name('function')
+    if function is None or function.type != 'identifier':
+        return None
+    arguments = node.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+    raw = lambda n: source[n.start_byte:n.end_byte].decode('utf-8')
+    decoded = []
+    for argument in arguments.named_children if arguments is not None else ():
+        value = _argument(argument, raw)
+        if value is _BAD:
+            return None
+        decoded.append(value)
+    return raw(function), decoded
+
+
+class _Rows(HTMLParser):
+    """Collect direct click facts while tracking v-for alias scopes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, parser):
+        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
+        self._parser = parser
+        self._frames = []
+        self._facts = []
+        self._valid = True
+
+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+        attributes = dict(attrs)
+        vfor = attributes.get('v-for')
+        self._frames.append((tag, _loop_scope(vfor) if isinstance(vfor, str) else {}))
+        clicks = []
+        for name in ('@click', 'v-on:click'):
+            value = attributes.get(name)
+            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+                clicks.append(value)
+        if len(clicks) == 1:
+            fact = self._event(clicks[0])
+            if fact is not None:
+                self._facts.append(fact)
+        if tag in _VOID:
+            self._frames.pop()
+
+    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
+        if tag in _VOID:
+            return
+        if self._frames and self._frames[-1][0] == tag:
+            self._frames.pop()
+        else:
+            self._valid = False
+
+    def _resolve(self, name):
+        for _, bindings in reversed(self._frames):
+            if name in bindings:
+                return name, bindings[name]
+        return _MISSING, None
+
+    def _event(self, expression):
+        decoded = _decode_event(self._parser, expression)
+        if decoded is None:
+            return None
+        handler, arguments = decoded
+        resolved = {self._resolve(alias) for alias, _ in arguments if alias is not None}
+        if len(resolved) != 1:
+            return None
+        row, collection = resolved.pop()
+        if collection is None:
+            return None
+        return {'collection': collection, 'row': row, 'handler': handler,
+                'arguments': [argument for _, argument in arguments],
+                'source_line': self.getpos()[0]}
+
+
+def row_events(html):
+    """Source facts for click handlers bound to v-for rows in one HTML string."""
+    collector = _Rows(Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language())))
+    collector.feed(html)
+    collector.close()
+    return collector._facts if collector._valid else []

 def test_selection_requires_entity_and_observed_identity(tmp_path):
     sources = dict(LIBRARY)
     sources['Reader.java'] = 'class Reader { @Id String key; String title; }'
     project, _, ids = build(tmp_path, sources)
     history = [{'action': 'List books', 'result': [
         {'__type__': 'Book', 'key': 'b2', 'title': 'Two'},
         {'__type__': 'Book', 'key': 'b1', 'title': 'One'}]}]
     assert selected_objects(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'Open book', history) == []
     assert selected_objects(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'Open reader', history) == []
     assert selected_objects(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'Open new book', history) == []
     assert selected_objects(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'Open third book', history) == []
     selected = selected_objects(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'Open second book', history)
     assert selected[0]['value'] == 'b1'
     history.append({'selected_objects': selected})
     assert history_value(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'key', 'Read book', history)[1] == 'b1'
     assert selected_field(project, 'title', {'bookId': 'b1'}, history)[1] == 'One'
     assert selected_field(project, 'title', {'bookId': 'b2'}, history) is None
     assert selected_field(project, 'title', {'readerId': 'b1'}, history) is None
 
 
 def test_conflicting_path_selections_are_unknown_after_join(tmp_path):
     project, db, ids = build(tmp_path, LIBRARY)
     initial = ScenarioState(db)

     alternatives = []
     for action in ('Open first book', 'Open second book'):
         state = deepcopy(initial)
         state.history.append({'selected_objects': selected_objects(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], action, state.history)})
         alternatives.append(state)
     joined = join_states(alternatives)
     assert joined.history[-1]['selected_objects'] is U
     assert history_value(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'key', 'Read book', joined.history) is None

     history.append({'selected_objects': selected_objects(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'Open first book', history)})
     assert history_value(project, ids['BookController.lookup'], 'key', 'Read second book', history)[1] == 'b2'

Supported subset (anything else is omitted, never guessed): * ``v-for`` with one bare alias or ``(alias, index)``, the ``in``/``of`` keyword, and a collection written as a single plain ASCII JavaScript identifier: ``v-for="(item, index) in myRows"`` / ``v-for="row in rows"``. Any other collection expression (member access, call, filter, parenthesis, literal) is unsupported: its aliases shadow matching outer aliases and arguments bound to it produce no fact. A malformed attribute shadows every identifier it mentions, so outer aliases of the same name never leak. * ``@click`` or ``v-on:click`` whose value is exactly one call to a direct identifier: ``edit(item.id, 7, 'x')``. Member callees, non-calls, malformed JavaScript and elements carrying both click attributes at once are omitted. * Arguments: ``alias.property`` with one direct property of the row alias, or a JavaScript string / finite number / boolean / ``null`` literal.
